Brain break. Take a brain break every forty minutes.

Sophia, it's Ruby. Help! The math test is tomorrow, and I haven't finished my flashcards. My mom says I'd better go to bed early, and she's right, I ought to sleep. But I really should look at the fractions one more time. Can you be my study buddy tonight, just for twenty minutes? We don't have to talk about anything else, I promise. Oh, and you'd better bring your highlighter. Mine ran out of ink!
